import ast, sys
src = open('exact.py').read()
tree = ast.parse(src)
# find unused names in functions (rough check)
import symtable
st = symtable.symtable(src, 'exact.py', 'exec')
def walk(t, path=''):
    for ch in t.get_children():
        if ch.get_type() == 'function':
            unused = [s.get_name() for s in ch.get_symbols() if s.is_assigned() and not s.is_referenced() and not s.is_global()]
            if unused:
                print(path + ch.get_name(), 'unused:', unused)
        walk(ch, path + ch.get_name() + '.')
walk(st)
print('symtable check done')
